        """
        Run the crawler asynchronously using asyncio.

        :param args: arguments to initialize the spider
        :param kwargs: keyword arguments to initialize the spider
        """
        if self.crawling:
            raise RuntimeError("Crawling already taking place")
        if self._started:
            raise RuntimeError(

            )

    This class extends :class:`~scrapy.crawler.CrawlerRunner` by adding support

    signals, like the keyboard interrupt command Ctrl-C. It also configures
    top-level logging.

    :mod:`~twisted.internet.reactor` within your application.

    The CrawlerProcess object must be instantiated with a
    :class:`~scrapy.settings.Settings` object.

        (default: True)

    This class shouldn't be needed (since Scrapy is responsible of using it

    """

    def __init__(
        self,

    ):
        super().__init__(settings)
        configure_logging(self.settings, install_root_handler)

class AsyncCrawlerProcess(CrawlerProcess):
    """
    A class to run multiple scrapy crawlers in a process simultaneously using
    asyncio.

    This class extends :class:`~scrapy.crawler.CrawlerProcess` by adding support
    for using asyncio event loop. It requires
    :class:`~twisted.internet.asyncioreactor.AsyncioSelectorReactor`.

    The AsyncCrawlerProcess object must be instantiated with a
    :class:`~scrapy.settings.Settings` object.

    :param install_root_handler: whether to install root logging handler
        (default: True)

    This class shouldn't be needed (since Scrapy is responsible of using it
    accordingly) unless writing scripts that manually handle the crawling
    process. See :ref:`run-from-script` for an example.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: dict[str, Any] | Settings | None = None,
        install_root_handler: bool = True,
    ):
        super().__init__(settings, install_root_handler)
        self._runner = AsyncCrawlerRunner(settings)

    async def start(self, stop_after_crawl: bool = True) -> None:
        """
        This method starts the asyncio event loop and runs the crawlers.

        If ``stop_after_crawl`` is True, the event loop will be stopped after all
        crawlers have finished, using :meth:`join`.

        :param bool stop_after_crawl: stop or not the event loop when all
            crawlers have finished
        """
        if stop_after_crawl:
            await self._runner.join()

    async def _stop_reactor(self, _: Any = None) -> None:
        """Stop the asyncio event loop."""
        from twisted.internet import reactor

        # raised if already stopped or in shutdown stage
        with contextlib.suppress(RuntimeError):
            reactor.stop()
